product_overview: PostBus is India Post shipping management software for Indian ecommerce merchants. It centralizes orders, bookings, labels, manifests, tracking, returns visibility, automation, and billing in a single multi-tenant workspace.
core_goals: Enable merchants to connect an existing India Post Customer ID and operate shipping workflows end-to-end.
Provide workspace-based order, shipment, label, manifest, and tracking management with tenant isolation.
Support operational visibility for NDR/RTO without carrier-side action APIs.
Automate common fulfillment tasks such as Shopify sync, booking, label generation, tracking sync, and printing.
Offer platform billing, trial, and subscription management through Razorpay for PostBus service usage.

features.name: Authentication and workspace onboarding
features.description: Users can register, log in, recover passwords, and automatically provision a workspace organization after first access.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid email and password -> Receive 200/201 with created user session -> GET /api/v1/me with session cookie -> Receive 200 with auto-provisioned organization and member role
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with authenticated session -> GET /api/v1/me -> Receive 200 with current user and workspace details
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with registered email -> Receive 200 acknowledgement -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with invalid or expired token -> Receive 400 with validation error

features.name: Orders management
features.description: Merchants can create, view, edit, import, and export orders from multiple sources including manual entry, Shopify, WooCommerce, API, and WhatsApp.
user_flows: POST /api/orders with valid order payload -> Receive 201 with order ID -> GET /api/orders/{id} -> Receive 200 with order details -> PATCH /api/orders/{id} with address or weight updates -> Receive 200 with updated order
GET /api/orders?page=1&limit=20 -> Receive 200 with paginated order list -> GET /api/orders/{id} -> Receive 200 with selected order details
POST /api/orders/bulk-status with order IDs -> Receive 200 with updated statuses -> GET /api/orders/export CSV endpoint -> Receive 200 with downloadable export
POST /api/orders with missing required customer or address fields -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> GET /api/orders/{id} for nonexistent order -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Inventory and product catalog
features.description: Merchants can manage products, stock levels, and stock movement events for fulfillment and returns.
user_flows: POST /api/inventory/products with product data -> Receive 201 with created product -> GET /api/inventory/products -> Receive 200 with product catalog list -> PATCH /api/inventory/products/{id} -> Receive 200 with updated product
POST /api/inventory/movements with reserve stock request -> Receive 200 with stock movement recorded -> GET /api/inventory/products/{id} -> Receive 200 with adjusted available quantity
POST /api/inventory/movements with quantity exceeding stock -> Receive 400 with insufficient stock error -> GET /api/inventory/products/{id} -> Receive 200 with unchanged inventory state

features.name: Shipment creation and India Post booking
features.description: Users can create shipments, book them with India Post CEPT for supported services, retry failed attempts, and manage bulk Excel booking workflows.
user_flows: POST /api/shipments with shipment and parcel dimensions -> Receive 201 with shipment draft -> POST /api/shipments/{id}/book -> Receive 200 with CEPT booking confirmation -> GET /api/shipments/{id} -> Receive 200 with booked shipment and tracking reference
POST /api/shipments/bulk-book with Excel-imported shipment rows -> Receive 202 with background job queued -> GET /api/shipments/{id} -> Receive 200 with booking results after processing

POST /api/shipments/{id}/book with invalid service or missing India Post customer configuration -> Receive 400 with booking validation error -> GET /api/shipments/{id} -> Receive 200 with draft or failed booking state
POST /api/shipments/{id}/retry-booking after a transient failure -> Receive 200 with retried status -> GET /api/shipments/{id} -> Receive 200 with final booking result

features.name: Labels and packing documents
features.description: Merchants can generate official India Post labels, custom labels, packing slips, and multi-print batches, with template customization and Unicode address layout support.
user_flows: POST /api/labels/generate for a booked shipment -> Receive 200 with label PDF metadata -> GET /api/labels/{id}/download -> Receive 200 with downloadable PDF -> POST /api/labels/multi-print with label IDs -> Receive 200 with batch print job
POST /api/labels/templates with custom layout settings -> Receive 201 with saved template -> PATCH /api/labels/templates/{id} -> Receive 200 with updated template configuration
POST /api/labels/generate with an unbooked shipment -> Receive 400 with generation error -> GET /api/labels/{id}/download for missing label -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Invoices and billing documents
features.description: Users can generate, retry, and customize invoice PDFs for orders and shipments.
user_flows: POST /api/invoices/generate with order ID -> Receive 200 with invoice PDF created -> GET /api/invoices/{id}/download -> Receive 200 with PDF download -> PATCH /api/invoices/{id}/customize -> Receive 200 with updated invoice template
POST /api/invoices/retry for a failed PDF generation -> Receive 200 with regenerated invoice status -> GET /api/invoices/{id} -> Receive 200 with invoice metadata
POST /api/invoices/generate with invalid order reference -> Receive 404 not found -> POST /api/invoices/generate with malformed payload -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Manifests management
features.description: Merchants can create and manage India Post manifests for booked consignments.
user_flows: POST /api/manifests with shipment IDs -> Receive 201 with manifest created -> GET /api/manifests/{id} -> Receive 200 with manifest details -> POST /api/manifests/{id}/download -> Receive 200 with manifest PDF
POST /api/manifests with shipments that are not booked -> Receive 400 with manifest eligibility error -> GET /api/manifests/{id} for nonexistent manifest -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Tracking pages and shipment visibility
features.description: The platform provides public tracking pages, branded tracking subdomains, and publish/unpublish controls for customer visibility.
user_flows: GET /track?awb={awb} -> Receive 200 with tracking timeline -> GET /api/tracking/{awb} -> Receive 200 with current shipment status -> POST /api/tracking/pages/{id}/publish -> Receive 200 with published state
GET https://{subdomain}.postbus.in/{awb} -> Receive 200 with branded tracking page -> POST /api/tracking/pages/{id}/unpublish -> Receive 200 with unpublished state
GET /track?awb={invalid} -> Receive 404 tracking record not found -> GET /api/tracking/{awb} for unknown AWB -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: NDR and RTO operations
features.description: Operations teams can review failed-delivery and return-to-origin cases from CEPT tracking in a read-only dashboard.
user_flows: GET /api/ndr-rto -> Receive 200 with NDR and RTO case list -> GET /api/ndr-rto/{id} -> Receive 200 with case details and tracking history
GET /api/ndr-rto?status=RTO -> Receive 200 with filtered return-to-origin list -> GET /api/ndr-rto/{id} -> Receive 200 with linked shipment information
POST /api/ndr-rto/{id}/reattempt with any payload -> Receive 405 or 400 indicating no carrier-side action support -> GET /api/ndr-rto/{id} -> Receive 200 with unchanged read-only case state

features.name: Automation controls
features.description: Merchants can toggle automations for Shopify sync, shipment creation, booking, labels, manifests, tracking sync, Shopify fulfillment, notifications, and auto-printing.
user_flows: GET /api/automation -> Receive 200 with current toggle states -> PATCH /api/automation with auto-booking and auto-print enabled -> Receive 200 with saved automation settings
PATCH /api/automation with invalid integration state -> Receive 400 with validation error -> GET /api/automation -> Receive 200 with previous settings unchanged
POST /api/automation/test-print with label job ID -> Receive 200 with print queue result -> GET /api/automation -> Receive 200 with auto-print configuration

features.name: Integrations setup
features.description: Merchants can connect Shopify, India Post Customer ID/CEPT, Wati, VaChat, and PostBus WhatsApp integrations.
user_flows: POST /api/integrations/shopify/oauth/start -> Receive 200 with redirect URL -> POST /api/integrations/shopify/oauth/callback with valid code -> Receive 200 with connected store details

POST /api/integrations/india-post/connect with Customer ID and credentials -> Receive 200 with verified India Post connection -> GET /api/integrations -> Receive 200 with connected integrations summary
POST /api/integrations/shopify/oauth/callback with expired or invalid code -> Receive 400 with OAuth error -> GET /api/integrations/shopify -> Receive 200 with disconnected state
POST /api/integrations/india-post/connect with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 or 400 authentication failure -> GET /api/integrations/india-post -> Receive 200 with connection error state

features.name: Support Center
features.description: Merchants can ingest customer support conversations, manage tickets, add notes, and use WhatsApp-linked identities and templates.
user_flows: POST /api/support/tickets with incoming customer issue -> Receive 201 with created ticket -> GET /api/support/tickets/{id} -> Receive 200 with ticket details -> POST /api/support/tickets/{id}/notes -> Receive 200 with saved internal note
GET /api/support/tickets?status=open -> Receive 200 with open ticket list -> PATCH /api/support/tickets/{id} with status update -> Receive 200 with updated ticket state
POST /api/support/tickets with missing customer context -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/support/tickets/{id} for unknown ticket -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Billing, trial, and usage quota
features.description: PostBus billing manages plans, trials, usage, and one-time Razorpay payments for the platform; booking quota is consumed only after successful India Post booking.
user_flows: GET /api/billing/plans -> Receive 200 with available plans -> POST /api/billing/checkout with selected plan -> Receive 200 with Razorpay order details -> POST /api/billing/webhook with payment success event -> Receive 200 acknowledgment and active subscription

GET /api/billing/usage -> Receive 200 with current quota and usage -> POST /api/shipments/{id}/book with successful CEPT booking -> Receive 200 booking success -> GET /api/billing/usage -> Receive 200 with quota decremented after success
POST /api/billing/checkout with invalid plan ID -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/billing/webhook with invalid signature -> Receive 401 unauthorized webhook

features.name: Super Admin platform operations
features.description: Platform administrators can manage accounts, subscriptions, plans, payments, revenue, trials, audit data, and AI credits from the admin area.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/accounts -> Receive 200 with platform account list -> GET /api/admin/accounts/{id} -> Receive 200 with account details -> PATCH /api/admin/accounts/{id} -> Receive 200 with updated lifecycle status
GET /api/admin/plans -> Receive 200 with plan catalog -> POST /api/admin/plans -> Receive 201 with created plan -> GET /api/admin/usage -> Receive 200 with revenue and usage metrics
GET /api/admin/accounts for non-admin user -> Receive 403 forbidden -> PATCH /api/admin/plans/{id} with invalid data -> Receive 400 validation error

print: print-agent Node process on packing PC

features.description: shopify-sync, shipment-booking, label-generation, tracking-sync, webhooks, invoices, notifications, support-ingest.

known_constraints: PostBus does not include India Post postage; merchants use their own Customer ID.
India Post CEPT has no NDR action endpoints (no reattempt/request RTO).
Platform Razorpay is Domain A billing only; not merchant store checkout.
Order quota consumed on successful India Post booking only.
Multi-tenant RLS via is_org_member; Super Admin via platform_admins.
